workspace_validation_commands: observed=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf -- "$observed"' EXIT; bash bin/run-batch --matrix visible --output "$observed"; python3 tools/validate_performance.py performance.json "$observed"
observed=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f -- "$observed"' EXIT; python3 bench.py --instrument instrumentation.py --output "$observed"; python3 tools/validate_performance.py performance.json "$observed"
observed=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f -- "$observed"' EXIT; python3 bench.py --json >"$observed"; python3 tools/validate_performance.py performance.json "$observed"
